title: Juicy Rendered Greek Lamb Skewers
description: A resinous and aerated Mediterranean dish featuring lettuce and render fat, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal. This show-off dish is sure to impress your guests.
instructions: Preheat the fondue pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the rendered lamb fat, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
Brush the mixture onto the lamb skewers, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers into the preheated fondue pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the lettuce and toppings by chopping and arranging them in a serving dish.
Once the lamb is done, remove it from the fondue pot and place it onto the prepared lettuce.
Top the lamb with feta cheese, kalamata olives, and artichoke hearts.
Make sure to cook the lamb to a safe internal temperature of at least 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
